new_claim.summary: For a physical cross block B0 and a spectral addition split at threshold h, arbitrarily large signed modes are free in amplitude when their restriction to one physical bank spans a diffuse r-dimensional footprint; the remaining arbitrarily many signed modes cost only h. A post-rank ridge effective-dimension lower bound plus a Schur-compression leverage shield yields a continuous density bound under explicit inequalities.
